title: Filters and AI lists
description: The server’s own blocked and allowed terms, plus the cases the AI moderation wasn’t sure about. The bot picks up changes within a few seconds.
settingsLinks: Turning filters on and off, punishments and point thresholds:
reviewsText: The AI moderation wasn’t sure about these. Block: the term goes on the block list. OK: it becomes allowed, and the bot revokes the points given for it (the member gets a DM). Dismiss: nothing to do.
blockedText: The word filter deletes the message, and the AI moderation adds points based on severity. Case and accents don’t matter. * stands for any number of letters: badword* also catches inflected forms, badword only the whole word.
emptyBlockedText: The built-in AI moderation works without them too — this is for the server’s own words.
allowedText: Things the AI would flag by mistake (e.g. the server’s slang, a game’s name). When you add one, the bot revokes the points previously given for it.
